title: The *cold* months
subtitle: Chapter one
description: Heavy cables and a cardigan to pull on over everything. Knitwear for mornings that start in the dark.

images.alt: A hand resting on a cream cable knit

title: By the *water*
subtitle: Chapter two
description: A loose knit over linen for long walks on the coast, when the wind picks up and the light turns gold.

images.alt: The ivory cable-knit cardigan from the front
A long sage cardigan worn over linen on the shore
An oversized cream jumper worn at home by a bright window

title: Every *day*
subtitle: Chapter three
description: The pieces you reach for without thinking: a fine knit tee with a ribbed crew neck that goes with everything.

images.alt: The Dusk & Sand colourblock knit tee
The Noir & Crimson contrast knit tee, side view
Folded knitwear stacked on a linen cloth beside a mug and a notebook

title: Finished by *hand*
subtitle: Chapter four
description: Before anything is folded and sent, the buttons are sewn on, the seams are pressed and every piece is checked by hand.

images.alt: The ivory cable-knit cardigan from the side, showing the cables down the sleeve
The terracotta cardigan's diamond stitch, buttoned to the neck
Hands smoothing a cream knit on the workbench
